diagnosis.original_evidence: User reported distorted main menu from Quest3/VDXR at 3440x1440, build 75ef9c91; no matching HMD re-test of the new source.
source_trace: OutRun's authored 4:3 front-end with 21:9 game-produced letterbox bars
GetGameUv crops source output to visible clipped screen intersection; PlanVisibleCenteredContent extracts native authored contents
R23 host previously recomputed sourceAspect from the visible fragment and drew that fragment as the whole optically centered menu in identical left/right layers
diagnosis.root_cause: On partially visible desktop client, PlanVisibleCenteredContent produced visible fragment aspect but discarded original authored center/size. R23 re-centered/scaled fragment as a complete menu; missing rows/columns caused enlarged/misplaced UI while capture changed.
alternatives_rejected: The game's original 4:3 sidebars are already drawn and verified by D3D9Ex letterbox code; this patch does not replace them
XR asymmetric-FOV common tangent math already maintains authored physical aspect on full captures; fragment misplacement arises after UV intersection, not eye-FOV averaging
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Main menu is one LOCAL fixed 4:3 raster shared through R23 projection to both eyes with identical UV and common FOV; game stereo HUD never enters this host fragment transform.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Keep original 4:3 optical projection and apply captured authored-fragment fractional offset/extent to the projected quad rather than using fragment aspect as a new complete menu.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy and C++ main-menu smoke passed; original 4:3/16:9/21:9, top/dual-axis clipping, invalid/reset negative cases, 5 destructive visual contract mutations, plus 5 queue child/claim policy mutations.
